title: Los Angeles weather: Series of storms moving into Southern California. Here's when you can expect rainfall - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Southern California to see morning shower chances Saturday, sunshine by Sunday - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 Saturday morning rain possible in SoCal before dry, sunny finish to the weekend 
 Shower chances will linger across parts of Southern California on Saturday morning before skies clear, setting up a mostly dry and sunny weekend. Saturday, November 14, 2026 4:43AM Share Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Shower chances will linger across parts of Southern California on Saturday morning before skies clear, setting up a mostly dry and sunny weekend. Another weather system, however, could bring rain back to the region early next week.
 Temperatures across the region are expected to remain in the 60s and 70s on Saturday as morning rain moves out. Sunshine and dry conditions are expected to return Sunday.
 Don't put the umbrella away just yet. A cold front is expected to move through parts of Southern California on Monday and linger into Tuesday. While the system is not expected to be particularly strong, it could bring additional chances for rain on both days.
 RELATED: What is an atmospheric river? Meteorologist Dallas Raines explains 
 Weekend forecast
 Los Angeles and Orange counties can expect clouds and a 30% chance of morning showers Saturday, with a high of 71 degrees and a low of 57. Expect sunshine and temperatures in the low 70s on Sunday.
 The valleys and Inland Empire will also see a 30% chance of morning showers Saturday, with a high of 71 degrees and a low of 54. Expect pleasant conditions Sunday, with sunshine and a high of 72.
 Morning rain is possible in beach communities Saturday. Expect a high of 67 and a low of 58, with surf between 3 and 7 feet.
 Mountain areas on Saturday will be cold, with a high of 48 degrees and a chilly overnight low of 28. There's a 60% chance of rain in the morning. Temperatures on Sunday increase to the low 50s but overnight lows will still be in the mid-20s.
 Deserts can expect slight rain chances Saturday morning, along with a high of 66 degrees and a low of 42. Palm Springs is expected to reach a high of 75 degrees.
